user_goal: Independently review the two frozen, isolated Main source candidates for the authorized retry repairs without changing files or expanding scope.

acceptance_scope.R1: Only the exact same-date research graph EXPECTED_MISSING placeholder may use the existing strict CAS/revision recovery path.
acceptance_scope.R2: A timely sealed source may be reused after a same-candidate-code retry only when attestation, source evidence, code and policy identities, cutoff, version, and full business content match; preserve original bytes and capture provenance. Cross-version identity mismatch remains a refusal.
acceptance_scope.excluded: Historical 0900 cross-version recovery, deployment/control review, native quote availability, and future natural acceptance.

review_steps: Read the frozen review capsule, diagnosis, R1/R2 scopes, and existing test results.
Matched candidate, preimage, patch, test, and result SHA-256 values to the frozen records.
Compared both candidate source files against the installed Main preimages.
Inspected the existing CAS/revision implementation and attestation reader used by the candidates.
Reviewed the targeted tests and their coverage against the frozen acceptance criteria.

BEHAVIOR_VERIFIED.isolated_candidate_cases: PASS based on reviewed candidate code, matching test hashes, and the existing R1/R2 PASS results

unexecuted_checks: Tests were not rerun, per the frozen repetition policy.
Final Main/Stage deployment controls and manifest binding were not provided or reviewed.
Deployment, service/runtime behavior, and the future natural slot were not exercised.
